reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Section 8.1 supplies a one-way Vendor (Commerce One) indemnity covering third-party claims that the Software infringes patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret rights, with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics and the conventional procure / modify-replace / terminate-and-refund remedy ladder; Section 8.2 exclusions are the usual non-conforming-use and third-party-modification carve-outs. This satisfies the fallback position.

Section 9 expressly carves Section 8 out of both the 12-month fees cap and the consequential-damages exclusion, so the IP indemnity is uncapped — better for us than the fallback's 3x super-cap, and no basis to flag.
No Customer-side indemnity exists in the agreement, so the 'Customer indemnity stays narrow' limb is satisfied by omission; per playbook semantics a clause at or above the fallback is not redlined.

Sub-element gaps short of the preferred position (no indemnity for Vendor breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct; refund tied to fees 'paid' only) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation.
